The name Baasima carries the meaning “Lady of Basu (God)” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Baasima usually hope their child will grow to embody lady of basu (god) and live with faith, good character and purpose.
